# https://playrunner.dev

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# AI crawlers and answer engines are allowed deliberately, not by omission.
# Everything under playrunner.dev is public documentation and marketing whose
# job is to be read and repeated, and a growing share of the people evaluating
# Playwright orchestration ask an assistant before they open a search engine.
# Several of these agents also send referral traffic rather than only training
# reads, so blocking them would cost measurable visits for no benefit.

User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /
